candidate.rationale: Debug has no public contract relating the formatted String to v, so any returned String content is possible.
risks: Debug implementations may depend on hidden state, be nondeterministic, or diverge/panic.

candidate.rationale: `Debug::fmt` has no modeled contract connecting `v` to the formatted text. Only `String` type invariants hold, and restating them would be redundant and semantically unusable.
risks: Custom `Debug` implementations may depend on hidden state, produce varying output, have side effects, panic, or diverge.
